description: The exact text the account owner's wallet signs (EIP-191) to read or act on its factor account, and when the signature expires (five minutes). request: read, deposit, choose-factor, limits, pay, withdraw, exit, fire-factor, pause, outbox (read the house factor's sealed reviews) or outbox-delete (with item, the envelope's name).

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

issued.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC time; now when left out.

name: account_request_message
title: Factor accounts: the text the owner signs
